outliers.video_title: Shoulder pain when reaching, putting on a coat, or lifting your arm?
outliers.why_it_worked: The title lists three hyper-specific, relatable physical actions — reaching, putting on a coat, lifting your arm — that shoulder pain sufferers experience daily, making viewers instantly self-identify and feel seen. It skips vague medical language and speaks the exact words a sufferer would use to describe their own pain, creating an immediate 'that's me' click impulse. The question format also implies an answer exists, lowering the barrier to click by promising a payoff without demanding commitment.
outliers.trend_or_evergreen: evergreen — shoulder pain from everyday movements is a persistent, search-driven problem that never goes out of season and compounds over time as the population ages
